content-block-2:
Understanding Pregnancy Checks

Pregnancy checks are essential veterinary ultrasounds that safely confirm or rule out pregnancy in dogs and cats. At VIMG, this service combines expertise and non-invasive technology to give pet owners peace of mind.

Accurate pregnancy detection helps manage your pet's health and guides important care decisions, from nutrition to timing of delivery. Precise answers early on can help prevent complications, reduce stress, and support the best possible outcome for both mom and babies.

Led by Dr. Armstrong, a board-certified small animal internist, our veterinary team uses advanced ultrasound techniques to perform pregnancy checks right in Miami-Dade and Monroe counties. Unlike general technicians or non-specialists, we provide comprehensive assessments and real-time recommendations tailored to your pet.

Whether you need a routine check or have concerns about abnormal behavior, our mobile and pop-up clinics make high-quality specialty care accessible throughout greater Miami-Dade and Monroe counties and surrounding communities.

What to Expect During a Pregnancy Check

Your pet's comfort and your peace of mind are our top priorities. When you schedule a pregnancy check with VIMG, you can expect expert care, clear answers, and respect at every step.

Initial Consultation and Medical History

Our veterinarians begin by gathering your pet's history and discussing any symptoms or behavioral changes. Dr. Armstrong will address your concerns, answer your questions, and explain the pregnancy check process to help you feel confident in the care your pet is receiving.

Non-Invasive Ultrasound Examination

A specialized ultrasound is performed to detect pregnancy safely and painlessly. Our ultrasound unit is fully mobile, allowing checks to be performed in a clinic setting or at a location that best suits your pet's comfort.

Unlike many competitor services, VIMG ensures that a board-certified specialist conducts and interprets every scan. Immediate results are given, eliminating anxious waiting or uncertainty.

Real-Time Results and Recommendations

Following the imaging, you’ll receive real-time updates on your pet's reproductive status. Dr. Armstrong will walk you through what the ultrasound shows, review the images with you, and discuss the next steps, whether your pet is pregnant or not.

This immediate feedback helps you make timely, informed decisions about prenatal care, nutrition, and monitoring. Recommendations are highly personalized to your pet's breed, age, and overall health.

Personalized Follow-Up Care

If your pet is expecting, our veterinary team provides ongoing guidance and support through pregnancy and beyond. We offer resources for home monitoring, nutrition advice, and information to recognize signs of labor or complications.

Our goal is to partner with you in ensuring a smooth, healthy pregnancy and delivery for your pet.
content-block-3:
Why Pregnancy Checks are Important for Your Pet

Accurate pregnancy checks are crucial for pet safety and peace of mind. Early detection allows you to provide appropriate prenatal care, schedule veterinary visits, and prepare for the birth process.

Pregnancy checks also help identify complications such as false pregnancies or potential risks requiring intervention. By verifying pregnancy early, you can avoid unnecessary stress and support your pet's health every step of the way.

Timely, expert pregnancy checks in Miami-Dade and Monroe counties from The Veterinary Internal Medicine Group help you:

Prevent Health Complications

Early detection of pregnancy, or issues such as singleton puppies or kittens, enables timely intervention. This can help avoid emergencies during delivery and support the health of both mother and offspring.

Ensure Appropriate Prenatal Care

Knowing your pet is pregnant means you can start optimal nutrition, supplements, and activity adjustments right away. Personalized advice prevents common problems and sets your pet up for success.

Gain Peace of Mind and Immediate Answers

Uncertainty about pregnancy can be stressful. Our real-time specialist assessments deliver the answers you need during the appointment, never leaving you waiting for results.

Signs Your Pet May Need a Pregnancy Check

Sometimes, it's not obvious if your dog or cat is pregnant. Look for these common signs that indicate a pregnancy check is needed:

  • Changes in appetite or eating habits
  • Noticeable abdominal enlargement or swelling
  • Behavioral shifts such as nesting or increased affection
  • Nipple enlargement or pinking up
  • Unexplained lethargy or reduced activity

If your pet is showing any of these symptoms or if you suspect exposure to an intact male, contact The Veterinary Internal Medicine Group promptly. Timely pregnancy checks in Miami-Dade and Monroe counties help ensure the health and safety of your pet and future puppies or kittens.

How Often Should Your Pet Receive a Pregnancy Check?

Most pets only require a single pregnancy check, typically scheduled two to three weeks after possible mating. However, confirmation timing can vary depending on species, breed, and reproductive history.

Our veterinary team may recommend additional checks for pets with a history of reproductive challenges, older animals, or in cases of suspected complications. Dr. Armstrong can tailor these recommendations to your pet’s individual needs to ensure the safest possible pregnancy and delivery.

If you are unsure when to schedule your pet’s pregnancy check in Miami-Dade and Monroe counties, our experts are here to advise you and provide clarity.
